Search operators reference

The query language accepts three operators. They may be combined in one query, and a quoted phrase is treated as a single term.

Table 3: Operators
OperatorExampleMeaning
site:site:example.org leasesRestrict the result to one host
-leases -auctionExclude a term
"""work stealing"Match the phrase exactly

An operator only applies to the term that follows it, so the order of terms in the query matters.
